title: Roadmap editing from the TUI: park, unpark and reorder
lead: On the Roadmap list, `P` parks the cursor item (or unparks it when it is parked), and `J` / `K` move it one place down / up in slicer's stored queue. Each key first shows the exact slicer command on the confirm bar; `y` runs it through the daemon, Enter and `esc` cancel. This folds S67 (park and unpark) and S68 (reorder) into one slice; S68 is retired after this is filed.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Parking and reordering are two of the three common edits that adj 11 (`ui.slicer-tui`, decided "both", 2026-10-20) keeps in ork; starting is already done by launch. Today the owner leaves ork for `slicer park` and `slicer move`. Scope: adj 173 (`scope.v1-ork-edits`) lists "roadmap reorder or park" as later than v1.0; the owner moved S67 and S68 into v1.1 on 2026-10-29 (slice notes) and the pair-wave plan keeps them (owner, 2026-10-31). Keys follow the owner interview of 2026-10-23: `P` toggles park and is refused on an item with an unfinished run; `J` and `K` move one place with a confirm that shows the exact command. `p` and `n` stay row keys (adj 112, `ui.row-keys`) and `j` / `k` stay row movement. Adj 98 (`ui.confirm`, "launch-stop") says only launch and stop confirm and leaves other writes open; the 2026-10-23 interview chose a confirm for these two, so the confirm is part of this slice, not a new record.

S68's Why says `internal/tui/roadmap.go` does not exist. That is stale: S12 is done and the file exists (`internal/tui/roadmap.go:1`; the list is drawn in `roadmap`, `internal/tui/roadmap.go:186`). There is no park or move wrapper yet: `rg -n "park|Park|Move" internal/slicercli/write.go` finds none.

What slicer does, so the keys are honest. `slicer park ID` / `slicer unpark ID` change status; parked items list last (`../slicer/docs/commands.md:38`, `:83`). slicer move with a --before, --after or --to flag reorders the stored queue, and that position only breaks ties: `list` orders by readiness group, declared pass, effective score, then stored order (`../slicer/docs/commands.md:32`, `:38`; `../slicer/docs/how-it-works.md:134-140`). ork's Roadmap shows `slicer list --json --lean` order (`docs/dashboard.md:1413`). So a move past a row of another pass or score leaves the shown order unchanged. This slice does not hide that: after the write the daemon says whether the list order changed, and the status line says so when it did not (see the open owner question in the manifest; the default below is the plain reading of the owner's 2026-10-23 answer).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Wrappers, in `internal/slicercli/write_test.go`:

- TestParkAndUnparkRunTheSlicerCommand: `Park(ctx, w, root, "S1")` runs `park S1 --render --json --root ROOT`; `Unpark` runs `unpark S1 --render --json --root ROOT`. Fails first: no such methods.
- TestMoveRunsBeforeAndAfter: `Move(..., "S1", "S2", "before")` runs `move S1 --before S2 --render --json --root ROOT`; `"after"` uses `--after`. Fails first: no method.
- TestEditWrappersRefuseEmptyArguments: an empty item, an empty other or a position other than `before` / `after` returns an error and makes no call.

Daemon, in `internal/daemon/items_test.go`:

- TestItemParkAndUnparkCallSlicerAndRefreshItems: `item.park` and `item.unpark` with `{"project","item"}` run the wrapper at the registered root and refresh Items and Deps. Fails first: unknown method.
- TestItemParkRefusedWhileTheItemHasAnUnfinishedRun: with a stored run record for the project and item whose state is not final, `item.park` returns code `refused`, names the run id, and runs no slicer write. A final run does not block. `item.unpark` is never blocked by a run.
- TestItemParkBadParams: a blank project, blank item or an unknown field is `bad_params`; an unregistered project is `not_found`.
- TestItemMoveRunsSlicerMove: params `{"project","item","other","position"}`; `position` `before` or `after`; any other value or a blank `other` is `bad_params`.
- TestItemMoveReportsWhetherTheListOrderChanged: the fake `slicer list` returns one order before the write and another after: the result has `changed` true; the same order both times: `changed` false. The daemon calls `List` once before and once after the write.
- TestItemEditKeepsSlicerErrorCodeAndMessage: a slicer refusal (for example `move` across kinds, `../slicer/docs/commands.md:512` region) comes back with slicer's code and message unchanged, as `item.note` does.

TUI, in `internal/tui/roadmapedit_test.go` (use the `noteLive` style double from `compose_test.go:16`):

- TestParkKeyAsksOnTheConfirmBar: on the Roadmap list `P` on an open row sets a confirm whose text is `slicer park S12? [y/N] (Enter is No)`; no daemon call yet.
- TestParkKeyOnAParkedRowAsksToUnpark: the text is `slicer unpark S12? [y/N] (Enter is No)`.
- TestEnterOnTheParkConfirmCancels: Enter, `n` and `esc` clear the confirm, show `Cancelled` and make no call.
- TestYesParksAndTheRowShowsParked: `y` calls `ItemPark` once with the project and item, shows a pending status, and after the refreshed snapshot the row carries the dim word `parked`.
- TestParkFailureShowsTheErrorVerbatim: a wire error shows `actionError(err)` on the status line (`docs/dashboard.md:24`, "Errors verbatim").
- TestMoveKeysShowTheExactCommand: `J` on row S12 with S13 below shows `slicer move S12 --after S13? [y/N] (Enter is No)`; `K` with S11 above shows `slicer move S12 --before S11? ...`.
- TestMoveAtTheFirstOrLastRowDoesNothing: `K` on the first row and `J` on the last set no confirm and no status.
- TestMoveYesKeepsTheCursorOnTheMovedItem: after `y` and a snapshot whose order differs, the cursor sits on the moved item, and `Moved S12 after S13` is the status.
- TestMoveThatLeavesTheOrderSaysSo: the daemon result has `changed` false: the status line reads `Queue order saved; the list is unchanged because pass and score rank first`.
- TestRoadmapEditKeysAreInactiveOffTheList: no confirm and no call with the item pane open, the matrix pane open, help open, off the Roadmap, with no project selected, on an unavailable project, with an empty list, and without a daemon (status `No daemon connection; action unavailable`, as `matrixRefusal` at `internal/tui/roadmap.go:57` gives it). A Live double without the optional interface says `Roadmap edit unavailable`.
- TestRoadmapEditHintsDropBeforeProjectEdits: at 100x30 the hint line offers `P park` and `J/K move`; at 80x24 the line is unchanged from today (`enter open; l launch; m matrix; tab views; q quit; ? help`, `docs/dashboard.md`, matrix paragraph).
- TestRoadmapParkedGolden (in `roadmapedit_test.go`, using `checkGolden` as `compose_test.go:297` does for `roadmap-new`): a roadmap with one parked item at 100x30, colour and mono.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests first and run them; each must fail for the reason given above.
2. `internal/slicercli/write.go`: add `Park(ctx, w, root, id)`, `Unpark(...)` and `Move(ctx, w, root, id, other, position)` over `c.write` with `--render --json`, trimming nothing and refusing empty arguments as `Note` does. `position` is `before` or `after`; map it to `--before OTHER` or `--after OTHER`.
3. `internal/daemon/wire.go`, `handlers.go`, `items.go`: methods `item.park`, `item.unpark` and `item.move` (*proposed* names). Params: `ItemParkParams{Project, Item}` (shared by unpark), `ItemMoveParams{Project, Item, Other, Position}`. Results: `{"item"}` for park and unpark; `{"item","changed"}` for move. Decode with the existing strict `decode`. In `itemPark`, before the write, look up the project's stored run records (the store read that `unfinishedRunsLocked` at `internal/daemon/runs.go:1224` does, under `d.runs.mu`) and return `&ipc.Error{Code: CodeRefused, ...}` naming the run id when a non-final record has `Item` equal to the item. In `itemMove`, call `Slicer.List` before and after the write and set `changed` when the item's index differs. After a successful write, refresh `source.Items` and `source.Deps`, as `itemNew` does. Leave the existing handlers alone.
4. `internal/daemon/client.go` and `internal/tui/daemon.go`: `ItemPark`, `ItemUnpark`, `ItemMove`, shaped like `ItemNote`. Declare the optional `roadmapEditor` interface in `internal/tui/roadmapedit.go` so Live doubles without it are refused politely.
5. `internal/tui/keys.go`: bindings `Park` on `P` / `shift+p`, `MoveDown` on `J` / `shift+j`, `MoveUp` on `K` / `shift+k` (the `G` / `shift+g` pair at `Last` is the pattern). Add them to `FullHelp`. Add hint tiers `dropMove = 18` and `dropPark = 17` so both drop before add, new and remove-project edits (16) and the 80x24 line is unchanged. Offer them only when `roadmapEditRefusal` says the key can act.
6. `internal/tui/roadmapedit.go` and `model.go`: `roadmapEditRefusal` (the conditions in the refusal test, silent where the matrix refusal is silent); `requestRoadmapEdit(verb)` builds a `runAction{verb: "park"|"unpark"|"move", project, item, ...}` and sets `m.confirm`. Extend `runAction.command` with `slicer park ID`, `slicer unpark ID`, and `slicer move ID with the --before flag or the --after flag and the other id` (the new fields are `other` and `position`); the default prompt at `internal/tui/model.go:1358` already appends `? [y/N] (Enter is No)`. In `callAction` route the three verbs to a new `startRoadmapEdit` before the generic action path, and handle the reply in a new `roadmapEditMsg` case (like `noteMsg`): on error show `actionError(err)`; on success refresh with `m.fetch(project, true)`; for a move set `m.roadmapFollow` to the item id and show `Moved ID after|before OTHER`, or the unchanged text when `changed` is false. In `apply` (`internal/tui/model.go:1067`), when `roadmapFollow` is set for that project and the snapshot's Items order differs from the one on screen, put `roadmapCursor` on the item and clear it; any row key also clears it, so a poll already in flight does not move the cursor later.
7. `internal/tui/roadmap.go`: for a row with `Status == "parked"` prefix the fields column with a dim `parked ` (ASCII, no glyph). Title room shrinks by that width (the existing `room` calculation).
8. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md` (change the two "stay later" sentences to say reorder and park are v1.1; add the paragraph: keys `P`, `J`, `K`, the exact-command confirm, Enter is No, the refusal on an item with an unfinished run, the `parked` word, the tie-break note about `slicer move`); `docs/design.md:103` (three wire rows); `PROJECT.md:67,113`.
9. Run `go test ./internal/tui -update`, then review the golden diff: only the two new `roadmap-parked-*` files may be added and no existing golden may change.
10. `CHANGELOG.md`, last (so a parallel slice's entry does not conflict): add one entry at the top of `## Unreleased`, marked *proposed*, naming the keys and `docs/dashboard.md`.
11. Do not touch: `internal/cli` (no `ork` command is added), `internal/engine`, `cmd`, the registry, or the Waves screen. Do not add `S69`'s `O` key or any mouse handling.

UI slice: UI pass (r14).
